visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young Asian man with short dark hair, wearing a beige baseball cap backward and a white T-shirt with 'TAIWAN' printed in pink, stands inside a brightly lit retail store. He holds a beige New Balance 9060 sneaker in its grey cardboard box, gesturing toward the camera with a smile. Rows of white sneakers on red-labeled 'CLEARANCE' shelves fill the background. (2) The scene cuts as a lightning-bolt graphic appears over the man's head for comic effect. He continues explaining something while holding a small red plastic bottle. A credit card icon and text about exchange rates appear as overlays. The lighting is consistent, bright, and even. (3) The camera zooms in on the price tag on the side of the shoebox, held by the man's hands. He points to a yellow circular sticker on the box. Yellow text overlays '台幣$4880' and '美金$129.99' flash on the screen to highlight price differences. (4) The man's face is briefly distorted using a 'funny face' filter with an oversized mouth and bulging eyes while he expresses exaggerated regret. He then shows the shoe again from multiple angles, highlighting its thick, textured sole and suede material. (5) The setting shifts to the outdoors in front of a New Balance store entrance with a red circular logo. The man walks toward the camera holding a large brown paper shopping bag. Large yellow '真香' (Amazing) characters appear on screen. Pink hearts and sparkles are added as post-production overlays as he gives a thumbs up.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Price Comparison -> Regret Logic -> Resolution/Purchase.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an entertaining shopping vlog aimed at showing the significant price difference between New Balance sneakers in Taiwan versus a US outlet. By using comedy, filters, and clear price breakdowns, the creator encourages viewers to hunt for 'steals' while traveling, framing the purchase as a lucky find.
